notes: Strongly motorcycle-focused: homepage self-describes as 'De grootste motorrijschool van Nederland' (the largest motorcycle driving school of NL); team shown as motor instructeurs (Alex, Mussi). Also offers car (B), trailer (BE/B+), moped (AM) and motor (A1/A2/A) per clickdrive.nl. Specialised in faalangst (test-anxiety) candidates (website + faalangst exam pricing). NO evidence of English-language instruction found; English-focused Den Bosch results in search were competitors (Scoobz, Start Driving, DriveYourWay), not Praktijkfixers -> english_instruction=unknown. Founding signal conflicting: bambelo.com lists '11 Jaren in bedrijf' (=> ~2015) and website logo asset path is /wp-content/uploads/2021/10; earliest review seen is Dec 2023/Jan 2024. Used '11 jaar' as basis (founding_year 2015, med confidence). Address discrepancy: official website contact page lists visit address Volkerakstraat 59, 5215 CS 's-Hertogenbosch (head office Merwedestraat 229, 3313 GT Dordrecht), while rijschoolspecialist.nl lists Demerstraat 10, 5215BC -> used website visit address. Ratings: bambelo composite 9.5/10 from 316 reviews (Google 295 + Klantenvertellen 21); rijschoolspecialist shows only 2 reviews (5.0). google_rating left null as no direct Google star value verified (composite is 9.5/10). CBR pass rate low: rijschoolspecialist 37% (284 exams, B); drivedutch.nl 44% pass / 62 exams (April 2026). Operates over a wide CBR exam-location area incl. Den Bosch, Dordrecht, Rotterdam region.
